arguments.text: Unresolved limits for Stage 2: inputs are assumed to be JSON-shaped with finite values; source IDs and required-condition names are assumed to be sortable strings. Records are assumed to contain sortable source IDs when eligible. The contract does not specify malformed container handling, duplicate records/source IDs, or supersession cycles/self-supersession; current implementation removes any source named by another eligible record and excludes self-comparison by record index.
